_comment: Drop the relevant block into ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) or %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Windows). Restart Claude Desktop. The brand-bridge command must be on PATH (e.g. `pip install brand-bridge` or `pipx install`).

brand-bridge-demo._note: The shipped demo tenant — no setup, in-memory data.

my-square-brand._note: Real Square sandbox. See docs/COOKBOOK/square.md for setup.

my-brand-via-uv._note: Run from a checkout without installing — useful for development.

my-brand-via-http._note: Streamable HTTP variant. Run `brand-bridge serve --tenant my_brand --http --port 8000` on the server, expose behind your reverse proxy. One process per tenant — fan out at the proxy layer (subdomain or path).
